notes.title: Vesper: Zero Light Edition out now!
notes.content:
[i]Do not go gentle into that good Vesper,
The children of men burn and rave at close of day;
Rage, rage against the rise of the Zero Light.[/i]

Vesper: Zero Light Edition is [b]OUT NOW[/b] as a free update for Vesper on PC.

[list]
[*] Updated puzzles and level design
[*] An unlockable Artbook with preliminary sketches and study
[*] New in-game assets and sprites
[*] Rebalanced gameplay
[/list]

Enjoy Vesper: Zero Light Edition on PC!

Moreover, the new DLC called Vesper: The Age of Zero Light - that features an exclusive book of the game that consists of a curated version of the in-game story, along with stills from cutscenes, ingame events, concept art sketches and a deep-lore timeline - is out now. If you're a die-hard fan of the game, you can't miss it for sure!

We’ll meet again in the Great Beyond, one day.

Cheers,
[i]Cordens Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Vesper: Zero Light Edition ready to drop on 12th May 2022!
notes.content:
[b]TITLE: !!!WARNING!!! ZERO LIGHT CONTAINMENT FAILED[/b]

It all began with a blessing.

In the ancient times the Children of the Makers were wandering around the galaxy, with no purpose, nothing to live or die for. 

The Pure Light was their gift, a blessing from their creators, a boon which let them rise above all the living things. They built floating cities, and marvelous machines, spreading their knowledge and wisdom anywhere they went. 

But the ancient evil, the everlasting darkness, waiting in silence at the edge of the universe, also craved for that light. They called it… the Zero Light.

Vesper: Zero Light Edition is coming as a free update for Vesper on PC.

[list]
[*] Updated puzzles and level design
[*] An unlockable Artbook with preliminary sketches and study
[*] New in-game assets and sprites
[*] Rebalanced gameplay
[/list]

Moreover, a new DLC called Vesper: The Age of Zero Light - that features an exclusive book of the game that consists of a curated version of the in-game story, along with stills from cutscenes, ingame events, concept art sketches and a deep-lore timeline - will come out the same day, on 12th May 2022.

Enjoy Vesper: Zero Light Edition on PC, launching on 12th May 2022.

We’ll meet again in the Great Beyond, one day.

Cheers,
[i]Cordens Interactive[/i]

notes.title: VESPER IS GOING SOLO! 🎉
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that from today, [b]Vesper will be self-published directly by Cordens Interactive[/b]. 

It's been a two-year run since we started developing Vesper: we poured ourselves in the game, infusing it with our heart and soul.
At the beginning of August we released the game on Steam, hoping to reach as many people as possible, looking out for sharing a glimpse of our imagination.
We perceived all the passion from all of those who enjoyed the game: it was not only about good reviews, but also about the words that were used to describe the game, and the overall experience. We are amazed by how people experienced the world of Vesper, put together the story behind it and shared their thought on what's really going on! 
Vesper is the first game for all of us at Cordens Interactive, a group of passionate people moving their first steps in the gaming industry, and your kind words are like fuel for our team. 🔥 

[b]Now, it's time for the next step. [/b]👣 

We want to ensure that Vesper can be known and played by an broader audience, and as we work on updating the game and planning our next projects we have also decided to take this difficult decision and start self-publishing the game.

It goes without saying that [b]now it's the best time to buy the game, as you can support Cordens Interactive directly while we work hard to improve Vesper[/b], and bring to life our next visionary world. 🗺️ 

We wanted, once again, thank you all for you support, and for being with us throughout this journey. ❤️ 
Stay tuned, we cannot wait to share more news about our projects in the next months.

Tommaso & Matteo
[i]Founders of Cordens Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Announcing CORSAIR iCUE Support!
notes.content:
Pull down your sunglasses and let all that gorgeous colour in! We’re proud to announce Vesper will feature support for [b]CORSAIR iCUE[/b]! Your [b]CORSAIR [/b]equipment will interact with the responsive lighting system to reflect the colours on the screen, or to accompany the actions of using the Drive Gun, controlling enemies or interacting with the menace of the Zero Light. The system supports all kinds of hardware, be it keyboards, mice, controllers or internal components like fans. The integration allows for total immersion into the world of Vesper, elevating the beautiful and eerie atmosphere of the game to an even higher level! 

Being chosen by [b]CORSAIR [/b]for this exclusive partnership really makes us proud! Getting this sort of recognition and confidence by a big brand, as an Indie developer on their way to ship their first game, gives us great confidence that other people also see the quality of Vesper. And luckily there’s not much time left until everyone can experience themselves what we’ve been pouring our hearts into over these last years. Vesper releases [b]July 30th[/b] and we’re so looking forward to sharing this project with you!

notes.title: Release Date + FINAL DEMO!
notes.content:
🎉 Ladies and Gentlemen, we finally have a release date! 🎉

The release of Vesper is right around the corner - [b]July 30th[/b], to be exact! We have been putting in a lot of hard work into polishing the game and creating a [b]new and improved demo[/b] and we're super exicted for people to soon get their hands on our love letter to the genre of puzzle-platformers! We're sure that especially fans of a more old-school approach will love this game! 

So after you took a look at our [b]release date trailer[/b], why not give the new (and FINAL) demo version a spin? We tried to show off as many of the games' mechanics as we could (without spoiling anything of course) and even players who completed our previous demo before might be [b]surprised[/b]! There's not only some never shown before new content, but tons and TONS of further improvements all-around! 

...and for our story-focused players: we might have hidden some small new lore bits as well 👀

Not much longer and we can finally fully show off what we've been working on over those last years. We sincerely hope you'll like what we've created and [b]please let us know[/b] what you think of the demo - either on the Steam forums or our community Discord ( [url=https://discord.gg/DRvqbZzaFJ]https://discord.gg/DRvqbZzaFJ[/url] )!

❤ Thank you so much! ❤

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hi humans!

We are releasing a small patch to address the most common issues some of you are experiencing with the Demo.

Thank you for everyone that played it in the last few days and took some time to provide feedback.
Here's is a short list of what changes with the new patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with final cutscene not showing up correctly.
[*] Fixed compatibility with screen aspect ratios different from 16:9.
[*] Added checkpoint to last part of the demo to prevent frustration from dying because of a Sentinel.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

As always, if you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist!

Until next time,
Tom

notes.title: Gamescom 2020: Vesper Demo is now live!
notes.content:
Sad times, right? If everything went as planned, we'd be in Cologne now, at our Booth. At Gamescom.  Damn. On the side: Gamescom morphed into a digital event this year. And we still joined forces with the Indie Arena Booth.  And that means for you: There is a playable demo of [b]Vesper[/b] available now. For a limited time.

The Demo contains a small part of the final game and is around 20 minutes long. Keep in mind that it is a very early demo - if this was regular show, we'd be standing right next to you, explaining you that for example the sounds are not final yet, that this and that animation is just a placeholder and all the other little details. We'd tease you with what is about to come.

On the other side: This way we can reach, hopefully, quite a few people. Due to the early state of the demo, keep in mind we'll be taking it offline again around September 7th. And now: Enjoy playing [b]Vesper[/b] for the very first time.
